title: IUIDocument
description: The project-defined iui/1 wire contract. Semantic validation additionally enforces safe expressions, data and URLs. Native nodes are recognized but unsupported by the portable renderer.

from.description: length: m, cm, mm, km, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi; mass: kg, g, mg, t, lb, oz; temperature: K, C, F; speed: m-s, km-h, ft-s, mph, kn; area: m2, cm2, km2, ft2, ha, acre; volume: L, mL, m3, gal-us, gal-imp; time: s, ms, min, h, d; pressure: Pa, kPa, MPa, bar, atm, psi; data: B, bit, kB, MB, GB, KiB, MiB, GiB

precision.description: Maximum significant digits, default 8; raw values are retained.

temperatureMode.description: Temperature only. Absolute includes scale offsets and must be >= 0 K; difference converts signed intervals without offsets.

rate.description: Units of this currency per one base-currency unit; null means unavailable.
